{{Quote|For so long, there were none who could match our speed. My friend, Rida Denru, was the fastest of us. Her guidance led us to an age of triumph and prosperity.|[[Madon Drees]]|<ref name="TOR:ED" />}}
'''Rida Denru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] and fastest [[Swoop racing/Legends|swoop racer]] of the [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] [[Horizon's Razor]]. She went missing sometime before [[3626 BBY]] while trying to rescue the Screamers from their debt to the [[Night Brokers]].<ref name="TOR:ED" />
